title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Clearing a Late Demurrage Invoice Line
content:
## When a demurrage line is uncollectible

On a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record, a demurrage invoice line dated after its invoicing deadline — the day charges stopped accruing on the record, advanced by the product's deadline days — is uncollectible. A line in that position is cleared by a waiver carrying the reason late invoice, sized under the late-invoice rules for demurrage. A detention line that was invoiced late does not fall under this page; the general invoice dispute rules, and they alone, deal with clearing it.

The comparison uses the line's own date and the date on which charges stopped as the record shows it.

## Clearing tool: `clear_late_invoice_2264ae48`

Held outside the standard tools, this one must be unlocked by the agent, who then calls it at the desk.

**Business effect.** A single waiver entry dated on the day of clearing is added to the free-time record under the reason late invoice, pointing to the invoice line it clears, and the billed party's balance on the record is lowered by the sum waived. The customer then sees the late-invoice waiver against the line and the lower balance.

**Arguments.**

- `dnd_id` — the free-time record carrying the invoice line; its reference number as the free-time record lookup lists it.
- `customer_id` — the billed party's customer reference number as listed by the customer profile lookup.
- `reference_event_id` — invoice reference of the line being cleared, as listed by the account entry lookup.
- `amount_usd` — the sum waived, a positive US dollar amount stated to two decimal places.

**Confirmation.** A completed clearance returns "Late-invoice waiver <waiver reference> of USD <amount> booked against invoice line <reference_event_id> on record <dnd_id>; balance due now USD <balance>.", with the remaining balance on the record in US dollars to two decimals. Output that starts with "Error:" indicates that the record reference given does not exist and that no waiver has been booked.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical dates, deadline assumed at 20 days)

| Charges stopped | Line dated | Collectible? |
|---|---|---|
| 2 March | 22 March | yes, dated on the deadline itself |
| 2 March | 23 March | no, cleared by a late-invoice waiver |
